changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'RollupPathLink') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [metrics].[RollupPathLink]( [RollupPathUid] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, [StartPosition] int NOT NULL, [EndPosition] int NULL, [IntersectTypeID] int NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_MetricRollupPathLink] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [RollupPathUid] ASC, StartPosition ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem_MetricRollupPath') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[RollupPathLink] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem_MetricRollupPath] FOREIGN KEY([RollupPathUid]) REFERENCES [metrics].[RollupPath] ([Uid]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [metrics].[RollupPathLink] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem_MetricRollupPath] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MetricRollupPathLink_IntersectType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[RollupPathLink] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricRollupPathLink_IntersectType] FOREIGN KEY([IntersectTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[IntersectType] ([ID]) ON DELETE SET NULL ALTER TABLE [metrics].[RollupPathLink] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricRollupPathLink_IntersectType] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_MetricRollupPathLink_IntersectType') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_MetricRollupPathLink_IntersectType ON [metrics].RollupPathLink ( IntersectTypeID ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_MetricRollupPathLink_RollupPath') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_MetricRollupPathLink_RollupPath ON [metrics].RollupPathLink ( RollupPathUid ASC ) END
